faq.q: Who is this sales infrastructure work for?
faq.a: Coaches, founders, agency owners, and operators who already sell through calls and are tired of booking, follow-up, CRM, or content eating the day.

faq.q: What gets installed in the first week?
faq.a: Call-booking infrastructure, follow-up and no-show recovery, CRM ownership, and content distribution tied to the pipeline. Booking pages and reminders typically go live within 24 hours.

faq.q: How long does the install take?
faq.a: Days 1–7 go live. Week 2 onward hardens CRM and admin. Inside 30 days the operating environment should stop relying on heroics.
Delivery and execution are guaranteed. Outcomes that depend on your market, effort, or closing skill are not.
